jobs.title: Customer Success Consultant
jobs.description:
Location:
Home or Office Based, (Must be based within United Kingdom)
Hybrid working:
Flexible home and office-based hybrid working available
Salary:
Starting salary £35,000 per annum, depending on experience, plus a generous annual bonus scheme of circa 20%
Application deadline:
27 September 2026

Role Overview:

Esri UK is looking for a Customer Success Consultant to join our Pre-Sales team, with a focus on supporting customers across the Transport sector, including Roads, Rail, Ports and Airports.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a strong technical understanding of GIS and the ArcGIS Platform who enjoys working closely with customers to solve real-world challenges. You'll work with both prospective and existing customers, providing technical guidance, delivering demonstrations and helping organisations understand how geospatial technology can transform their operations and decision-making.
Working as part of our collaborative Pre-Sales team, you'll support sales opportunities, contribute to sector growth and help shape the future use of GIS across one of the UK's fastest-growing sectors.

As a Customer Success Consultant, you will:

Provide technical guidance and demonstrations of ArcGIS software and data to support customers and sales opportunities within the Transport sector.
Work alongside Account Managers to understand customer challenges and demonstrate how ArcGIS technology can address their business needs.
Support the identification and progression of sales opportunities through technical discovery, demonstrations and solution recommendations.
Deliver engaging presentations, webinars and customer-facing content to support marketing campaigns and industry events.
Apply business analysis techniques to understand customer requirements and contribute to recommended GIS solutions.
Develop and share best practice knowledge relating to ArcGIS and its application within the Transport sector.
Create and maintain sales enablement materials, demonstrations and sector-specific content to support colleagues and customers.
Act as a subject matter expert within the wider Pre-Sales team, providing technical support and mentoring to colleagues and graduates.
Build strong relationships with customers, partners and other stakeholders across the geospatial community.
Stay up to date with Transport industry trends, GIS developments and emerging technologies.

You would make a great Customer Success Consultant if you have:

A strong working knowledge of the ArcGIS Platform, including ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Pro, web applications, mobile applications and supporting data products.
Experience of applying GIS technology to solve business problems and deliver value for customers.
Confidence working directly with customers and presenting technical solutions to a variety of audiences.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and articulate the business benefits of ArcGIS solutions.
Strong relationship-building skills and enjoy working collaboratively with customers and colleagues.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-focused approach.
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently when required.
A keen interest in the Transport sector and how geospatial technology can support Roads, Rail, Ports and Airports.
Experience within the geospatial, transport, engineering, infrastructure or related industries (desirable).
Experience with CAD or design technologies (desirable).
A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel across the UK, including occasional overnight stays (desirable).
Eligibility and willingness to undergo security clearance when required.

Why join us?

At Esri UK, you'll be part of a growing, ambitious company where people are encouraged to bring their ideas, develop their careers and make a real difference.
We're proud of our culture. We believe in working collaboratively, sharing knowledge and supporting each other, while giving our people the trust and flexibility to do their best work.
You'll have the opportunity to work with talented people, learn from experts in their fields and contribute to work that has a genuine impact on communities, businesses and the environment.
If you're looking for a role where you can grow, make a difference and be part of a team that cares about what it does, we'd love to hear from you.

We offer:

Generous annual bonus scheme (circa 20%)
6% company pension
Private healthcare and Cash plan
Monthly gym/wellbeing contribution
Enhanced family-friendly policies
Paid volunteering opportunities
Cycle to Work scheme
Flexible working and support for continual learning and development
& more!

Who are we?
Esri UK is the country's leading geospatial technology company, helping organisations understand the relationship between people, places and data to solve real-world problems that affect communities, businesses and the environment each and every day.
Behind every map is a story. From tackling climate resilience and supporting sustainability goals to enabling digital transformation and economic growth, our technology helps organisations understand what's happening, why it's happening and what action to take next.
We're a growing, ambitious business with a strong culture, a passion for innovation and a commitment to developing our people.
How to apply:
Please apply via https://www.esriuk.com/en-gb/careers/vacancies with your CV, cover letter and salary expectations.

Application deadline:
27 September 2026

Esri UK is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise the importance and value of having a diverse and inclusive workforce and the benefits this brings to both our employees and our customers.
No agencies please.

Job function

Information Technology, Sales, and Other

Industries

Energy Technology, Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage, and Space Research and Technology

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
Home-based with UK travel
Hybrid working:
Home-based role with regular travel to Defence sites, partners and events across the UK. Some overnight stays may be required.
Salary:
Competitive salary from £39,000 (higher depending on experience) + circa 20% bonus + car allowance
Application deadline:
27 September 2026

Role Overview:

We're looking for an experienced and commercially minded Customer Success Manager to help expand and strengthen our footprint across the UK Defence sector.
This role is ideal for someone with experience in Defence, the MOD, Defence supply chains, or Defence corporate services, who has a background in customer success, account management, business development, or relationship management. You'll work closely with customers to maximise the value they receive from their investment in Esri technology, while identifying opportunities to grow strategic relationships and support long-term adoption.
If you're motivated by supporting mission-focused organisations and helping them unlock the full potential of geospatial technology, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing:

Building trusted relationships across Defence organisations, including MOD departments, corporate services, enabling functions and Defence prime contractors.
Acting as a strategic advisor, helping customers maximise value from their ArcGIS investment.
Managing and growing existing Defence accounts through proactive engagement and customer success planning.
Identifying opportunities to expand GIS adoption across departments, programmes and teams.
Working with customers to understand business challenges and align Esri solutions to their objectives.
Supporting the development and progression of opportunities through Defence procurement routes and frameworks.
Engaging with Defence and National Security partners, integrators, DIPS and Aurora partners, and the wider Defence supply chain.
Collaborating with Professional Services, Project Management, Support and Technical teams to resolve customer issues and deliver successful outcomes.
Preparing customer success plans, proposals, presentations and executive-level briefings.
Contributing to sector growth by promoting best practice, innovation and long-term customer success.

Candidate requirements:

We're looking for someone who:
Has experience working within Defence, the MOD, National Security, or the Defence supply-chain ecosystem.
Has a background in Customer Success, Account Management, Business Development or a similar customer-facing role.
Understands how Defence organisations operate, make decisions and procure technology.
Is confident working with a wide range of stakeholders and building relationships at all levels.
Can translate customer challenges into clear, value-focused outcomes.
Has excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills.
Holds, or is able to obtain, the necessary security clearances.
Has an interest in geospatial technology and GIS, or experience applying technology within Defence environments.

Why join us?

Esri UK is a thriving organisation offering the stability of a financially secure, market-leading technology company. We encourage teamwork, celebrate contributions, and reward success with a generous bonus scheme and comprehensive benefits package.
Our benefits include:
Generous bonus scheme (circa 20%)
Car allowance
6% company pension contribution
Private healthcare
Gym and wellbeing contribution
Cycle to Work scheme
Enhanced family-friendly policies
Paid volunteering opportunities
Flexible working arrangements
Ongoing learning and development support

Who are we?

Esri UK is the UK's leading provider of Geographic Information System (GIS) technology and the distributor of ArcGIS, the world's leading GIS platform. We help organisations across Defence, National Security, government and commercial sectors gain greater insight from their data through location intelligence.
Our people are passionate about technology, innovation and delivering exceptional customer outcomes. We invest heavily in our employees and pride ourselves on creating an inclusive, collaborative and supportive culture where people can thrive.

How to apply:

To apply, please submit your CV and a covering letter outlining your suitability for the role, together with your salary expectations.

Apply via our vacancies page: https://www.esriuk.com/en-gb/careers/vacancies

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion
Esri UK is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can succeed. We believe that different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences help us build stronger teams and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

No agencies please.

jobs.title: Principal Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Fin is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.

Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.

What's the opportunity?

As an Enterprise CSM, you’ll partner with our largest and most complex enterprise customers to help them succeed in the new era of AI-driven customer service. You’ll work with C-suite leaders and their teams to guide them through their AI Agent transformation with Fin — as both a Customer Agent and a Service Agent — from early project scoping and requirements gathering, to measurable adoption, to industry-best automation rates and business outcomes.

This role is an opportunity to shape how the world’s leading companies deploy AI to transform their customer and support operations — and to achieve strategic outcomes aligned to their business goals.

What will I be doing?

Develop trusted advisor relationships with customers (from c-suite stakeholders to individual contributors across a focused portfolio of high-value enterprise accounts.
Facilitate requirements gathering and process mapping for the customer’s standard operating procedures; document in clear, precise, and actionable terms.
Act as a transformation architect influencing customer strategy at the highest levels and defining automation and AI maturity roadmaps that drive structural cost reduction, CX innovation, or both.
Collaborate with engineers to translate customer requirements into Fin solution designs, guiding the customer on configuration best practices and prompt strategy.
Monitor Fin usage patterns to identify risks, recommend optimizations, and uncover expansion opportunities.
Maintain deep product knowledge of Fin’s fast-expanding capabilities; remain market aware of the fast evolving AI-agent industry.
Lead Success Plans, QBRs/EBRs, and strategic planning sessions with executive stakeholders hold yourself and your customers accountable to clearly defined milestones and measurable outcomes.
Quantify and communicate customer value through ROI metrics, outcome narratives, and executive briefings — building compelling business cases for continued and expanded investment.
Partner with Sales and Renewals to protect GRR, drive growth and progress further exposure of Fin to our customers' challenges.
Prioritize competing demands to drive the highest-value outcomes across your customer portfolio.
Be the Voice of the Customer internally, advocating for customers’ needs and shaping our solutions strategy.

What skills do I need?

8+ years of customer-facing experience in management consulting, strategy, advisory, or enterprise SaaS CSM roles.
Experience with business process mapping, requirements analysis, and solution design at enterprise scale.
Strong technical acumen and genuine passion for AI — comfortable engaging with technical concepts and holding meaningful conversations with engineering and product teams (coding not required).
Ability to evaluate AI performance data — automation rate, resolution rate, CSAT deflection — and translate metrics into compelling business outcomes.
Strong commercial instincts: understands enterprise procurement cycles and how to frame value for CFO and CX executive audiences.
Ability to simplify and communicate complex problems clearly across audiences — from technical teams to boards.
Experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programmes involving AI, automation, or modern customer service platforms.
Ability to apply a deep understanding of product roadmap to enhance customers’ automation strategies and deliver measurable outcomes.
Proven ability to manage multi-threaded Success Plans across complex enterprise accounts, aligning multiple stakeholders and workstreams to drive coordinated outcomes.
Self-motivated, adaptable, and intellectually curious — a leader among peers with a high level of self-efficacy.

At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements.

Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers.

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.

Fin values diversity and is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity. Fin will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Land Assembly Officer
jobs.description:
Role Overview

In this role, you will take ownership of your own projects while being embedded within the client’s organisation. Projects will vary in scale and complexity, from small negotiations to large infrastructure developments across both rural and urban environments. You will also work closely with a regional Savills team to support the overall delivery of client services.

This is a home-based position with access to our offices in Lincoln, York, Leeds, and Newcastle.

Key Responsibilities and Skills:

Proactively manage multiple concurrent projects, prioritising workload and tracking progress to meet deadlines.
Lead negotiations for land consents, acquisitions, and compensation claims.
Communicate effectively with colleagues, clients, and line managers to ensure successful project delivery.
Provide clear, reasoned advice and recommendations to clients.
Facilitate new customer connections, lease renewals, and land acquisitions for substations and underground cable infrastructure.
Demonstrate a solid understanding of billing processes, financial responsibilities, and accurate time recording.
Collaborate across Savills disciplines to deliver integrated and high-quality services.
Maintain strong client and customer relationships, ensuring satisfaction and trust.
Exhibit dependability, resilience, and a commitment to delivering results.
Professional qualifications such as MRICS and/or FAAV are desirable, but not essential.

We welcome applications from candidates with relevant experience.

Click
here
to download the full job specification. Please ensure you read this before applying.

What we offer you:

Career and Professional Development
25-30 Days Annual Leave, depending on grade
Life Assurance
Private Medical Scheme
Virtual GP
Global Mobility Scheme
Rewards Platform
Company Pension Scheme
Enhanced Incremental Annual Leave

Find out more about Savills offer

Team Overview

Savills Land Assembly team in the North of England support a wide range of utility and infrastructure projects, from the installation or removal of a single electricity pole, to full overhead line rebuilds. Our role includes identifying and engaging stakeholders impacted by the works and obtaining necessary permissions to proceed.

The wider Rural division operates across the UK, with a network of 37 offices and 13 disciplines. At Savills, we know that everyone thrives and develops in their own way, and we have various tools and training to help you achieve your career goals. Working with us means being part of a welcoming and collaborative environment where you will work with colleagues to push our industry forward.

This role does not meet the salary criteria for skilled worker visa sponsorship(click link to check exemptions).

To be eligible to apply for this role you must hold your own right to work in the UK. Please take the time to check here that you're able to make a new application to us now. Our employees act with honesty and integrity so we expect the same from you. We take any attempts to circumvent this policy very seriously.

Recruitment agencies

Savills only pay agency fees where we have a signed agreement in place and that agency has been previously contacted and directed by a member of our recruitment team. We do not pay agency fees when speculative and unsolicited CVs are submitted to Savills or any of our employees other than via our careers website and through our recruitment process. If this is not adhered to, agency fees will not be paid.

Submission of any unsolicited CVs or proposals to Savills will be deemed evidence of full and unlimited acceptance of this approach.

Over 42,000 people work for us in more than 70 countries all over the world. This breadth of global coverage, combined with specialist services and market insight, means we'll always have an expert who is local to you.

new_jobs.description:
Role Overview

In this role, you will take ownership of your own projects while being embedded within the client’s organisation. Projects will vary in scale and complexity, from small negotiations to large infrastructure developments across both rural and urban environments. You will also work closely with a regional Savills team to support the overall delivery of client services.

This is a home-based position with access to our offices in Lincoln, York, Leeds, and Newcastle.

Key Responsibilities and Skills:

Proactively manage multiple concurrent projects, prioritising workload and tracking progress to meet deadlines.
Lead negotiations for land consents, acquisitions, and compensation claims.
Communicate effectively with colleagues, clients, and line managers to ensure successful project delivery.
Provide clear, reasoned advice and recommendations to clients.
Facilitate new customer connections, lease renewals, and land acquisitions for substations and underground cable infrastructure.
Demonstrate a solid understanding of billing processes, financial responsibilities, and accurate time recording.
Collaborate across Savills disciplines to deliver integrated and high-quality services.
Maintain strong client and customer relationships, ensuring satisfaction and trust.
Exhibit dependability, resilience, and a commitment to delivering results.
Professional qualifications such as MRICS and/or FAAV are desirable, but not essential.

We welcome applications from candidates with relevant experience.

Team Overview

Savills Land Assembly team in the North of England support a wide range of utility and infrastructure projects, from the installation or removal of a single electricity pole, to full overhead line rebuilds. Our role includes identifying and engaging stakeholders impacted by the works and obtaining necessary permissions to proceed.

The wider Rural division operates across the UK, with a network of 37 offices and 13 disciplines. At Savills, we know that everyone thrives and develops in their own way, and we have various tools and training to help you achieve your career goals. Working with us means being part of a welcoming and collaborative environment where you will work with colleagues to push our industry forward.

Recruitment agencies

Submission of any unsolicited CVs or proposals to Savills will be deemed evidence of full and unlimited acceptance of this approach.
